title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect and build high-scale, resilient SaaS applications using React, Node.js/Python, and cloud infrastructure. You will lead technical design, write clean and tested code, collaborate with product designers, and optimize backend APIs for performance and low latency.
responsibilities: Architect and scale end-to-end full stack web platforms
Develop responsive and accessible web applications using React and TypeScript
Build high-throughput microservices and RESTful APIs
Mentor junior developers and participate in code reviews

title: Frontend React Developer
description: Join our frontend engineering team to craft delightful, snappy, and responsive web user interfaces. You will work closely with UX/UI designers to transform Figma designs into pixel-perfect, accessible React components with smooth animations and state management.
responsibilities: Build modern, accessible frontend web interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS
Optimize Core Web Vitals, page rendering performance, and bundle size
Collaborate with product and design teams on user research and prototyping

title: Backend Python / Cloud Engineer
description: Seeking a Backend Engineer proficient in Python, Flask/FastAPI/Django, and asynchronous architectures. You will develop resilient data pipelines, integrate third-party payment and AI services, optimize database schemas, and manage scalable cloud workloads.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain high-performance REST and asynchronous backend services
Design database schemas, query optimizations, and caching layers with Redis
Implement security best practices, JWT authentication, and RBAC

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join our AI innovation lab to design, train, evaluate, and deploy NLP and machine learning models in production. You will work with LLMs, transformer architectures, vector embeddings, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and MLOps deployment pipelines.
responsibilities: Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and NLP models for classification and matching
Build scalable inference pipelines and embedding search algorithms
Collaborate with data engineers to curate and preprocess large unstructured datasets

title: Data Scientist
description: Looking for a Data Scientist to extract actionable insights from user behavior and market data. You will build statistical predictive models, design A/B testing frameworks, generate data visualizations, and present data-backed recommendations to leadership.
responsibilities: Perform exploratory data analysis and hypothesis testing on large user datasets
Develop predictive regression and classification models to boost user retention
Create executive dashboards and visual reports

title: DevOps & Cloud Platform Engineer
description: We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to manage our Kubernetes clusters, automate CI/CD pipelines, ensure 99.99% uptime, and enforce infrastructure-as-code across multi-cloud environments (AWS / GCP).
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain production Kubernetes infrastructure
Automate zero-downtime deployment pipelines and release management
Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response runbooks

title: Mobile App Developer (React Native / Flutter)
description: Develop high-performance, cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. You will build buttery-smooth 60fps animations, integrate offline storage, handle push notifications, and release updates to Apple App Store and Google Play.
responsibilities: Build and maintain cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android
Implement offline sync, push notifications, and biometric authentication
Optimize rendering performance and battery consumption

title: Cybersecurity & Application Security Analyst
description: Protect our SaaS infrastructure and customer data against vulnerabilities. You will perform threat modeling, SAST/DAST vulnerability scans, code security audits, penetration testing, and incident response planning.
responsibilities: Conduct regular penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web apps
Audit cloud architectures and enforce least-privilege IAM policies
Lead incident investigation and compliance audits

title: Data Engineer (Big Data & ETL)
description: Architect scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and streaming ingestion layers. You will work with Apache Spark, Airflow, Snowflake/BigQuery, and SQL to power real-time analytics and ML feature stores.
responsibilities: Design and maintain reliable batch and streaming data pipelines
Build optimized dimensional data models for business intelligence
Ensure data quality, lineage, and governance across all data sources

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Design, build, and execute end-to-end automated testing suites for web and API systems. You will champion software quality, establish test coverage goals, and integrate test suites into continuous deployment pipelines.
responsibilities: Author automated E2E and regression test suites using Playwright or Cypress
Perform automated API contract and integration testing
Collaborate with developers to triage bugs and establish quality metrics

title: Product Manager (Technical / SaaS)
description: Drive the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our AI-powered SaaS solutions. You will synthesize customer feedback, work closely with engineering and design, and deliver impactful product milestones.
responsibilities: Define and communicate product strategy, vision, and quarterly OKRs
Lead cross-functional sprints with engineering, design, and growth teams
Analyze product metrics to optimize user onboarding and feature adoption

title: UI/UX Product Designer
description: Create intuitive, elegant, and frictionless user experiences for web and mobile products. You will build high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma, conduct usability interviews, and develop comprehensive design systems.
responsibilities: Craft modern, intuitive UI components and design systems in Figma
Conduct user interviews and translate usability insights into polished workflows
Partner with frontend engineers to ensure design fidelity in production

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: Lead enterprise cloud migration, multi-region architecture, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
responsibilities: Define multi-region cloud topology and fault-tolerant architecture standards
Advise engineering teams on distributed systems design and scalability
Optimize infrastructure cost efficiency and security governance

title: NLP / AI Research Engineer
description: Research and engineer proprietary natural language understanding systems, document parsing algorithms, semantic entity extraction, and intelligent matching engines.
responsibilities: Build semantic search and document extraction algorithms
Fine-tune custom NER models and classification rules for resume parsing
Measure matching accuracy and minimize false positives

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Great opportunity for an enthusiastic junior developer or recent graduate. You will write clean code, fix bugs, build small features across the frontend and backend, and learn modern software engineering best practices.
responsibilities: Implement user stories and bug fixes across web applications
Write unit tests and maintain clean documentation
Learn and grow alongside senior engineering mentors

title: Backend Go / Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Build high-concurrency, ultra-low latency distributed backend systems and microservices in Go. You will handle millions of requests per second with gRPC, Kafka, and distributed caches.
responsibilities: Architect and implement concurrent microservices with Go and gRPC
Optimize message throughput and database indexing for high load
Maintain distributed tracing and observability with OpenTelemetry

title: iOS Swift Developer

responsibilities: Develop responsive and modern native iOS applications in Swift
Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate REST and WebSocket endpoints
Maintain 99.9% crash-free sessions across all iOS devices

title: Database Administrator & Data Ops Engineer
description: Ensure high reliability, automatic backups, query tuning, sharding, and replication for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB clusters.
responsibilities: Manage and tune production database clusters for high throughput and uptime
Implement automated point-in-time recovery and failover mechanisms
Audit slow queries and guide developers on optimal schema design

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence & Incident Responder
description: Lead threat hunting, security telemetry analysis, incident triage, and forensic investigations to safeguard enterprise infrastructure.
responsibilities: Detect and respond to complex cyber incidents and security breaches
Analyze security telemetry, firewall logs, and endpoint detections
